description: Every price, yield and spread quote of a bond, solved from any one of them.

asw_market.description:
Asset swap market spread (decimal). `None` under the same rule as
`asw_par`, including on a plain floating-rate note, which the `asw_market`
metric alone would still value.

asw_par.description:
Asset swap par spread (decimal). `None` unless the bond has a fixed coupon
and no custom cashflows, or custom cashflows with a floating specification.

clean_price_currency.description: Clean price in the bond's currency, for its whole notional.

clean_price_pct.description: Clean price as percentage of par (`99.5` = 99.5%, the quote convention).

dirty_price_currency.description:
Dirty price at the quote date in the bond's currency, for its whole
notional: clean price plus accrued interest to the quote date.

discount_margin.description: Discount margin (decimal). `None` unless the bond has floating coupons.

i_spread.description:
I-spread (decimal): the yield less the swap par rate. On a bond with
exercise rights the yield and horizon are the worst exit's.

japanese_simple_yield.description: Japanese simple yield (単利, decimal). `None` unless the coupon is fixed.

moosmuller_ytm.description:
Moosmüller yield to maturity (decimal): simple interest to the next
coupon, then periodic compounding.

oas.description: Option-adjusted spread (decimal), from the bond's tree model.

ytm.description: Street yield to maturity (decimal), compounded at the coupon frequency.

ytw.description: Yield to worst across every call, put and maturity exit (decimal).

z_spread.description:
Z-spread over the discount curve (decimal). On a bond with exercise
rights it discounts the worst exit's flows.

title: BondQuoteSet
